sections.changelog:
1.3.10

  • Kept signed catalog identity independent of WooCommerce customer-language and session filters.
  • Kept the Hebrew and English pantry available after cart-language changes and item removal.
  • Read stock identity and immediate catalog verification from the raw WooCommerce edit context.

1.3.9

  • Published a bilingual, food-first pantry catalog with 26 linked ingredient products and opening stock.
  • Presented approved dish and product images normally without archive notices or unusual public treatment.
  • Separated public catalog and cart readiness from the electronic payment launch gate.
  • Added exact WooCommerce dependency verification and fail-closed recovery for dependency and catalog materialization.
  • Normalized WooCommerce page option types across cache flushes so strict catalog readback stays deterministic.
  • Kept the approved WordPress presentation authoritative, applied synchronized publication controls per dish, set WooCommerce visibility to live and purged host page caches after commit.
